entry.summaryHtml: Brazilian wood, roasted nuts, coffee, earth and a light herbal sweetness make the Gold Cigarillo a restrained but distinctive Brazilian smoke. The narrow format keeps it dry and aromatic, with a woody-nutty centre and a short coffee-and-herb finish rather than heavy pepper or syrupy sweetness.
